whiteCollar.title: White Collar Staffing
whiteCollar.description: We provide qualified professionals for engineering, project management, administration, finance, procurement, planning, HSE, QA/QC, HR, document control, and other technical and management positions.

blueCollar.title: Blue Collar Manpower Supply

projectBased.title: Project-Based Workforce Solutions

recruitment.title: Recruitment & Mobilization
recruitment.description: Our recruitment specialists ensure timely sourcing, screening, documentation, deployment, and workforce management, enabling clients to maintain productivity while reducing recruitment challenges.

outSourcing.title: Outsourcing Solutions

payroll.title: Payroll Support
